units: USD per million tokens unless the key says otherwise. 1 GitHub AI credit = 0.01 USD.
source_doc: facts.md in this folder; fact_ids point at its tables

models.label: Claude Opus 5.5
models.note: Same rates on Anthropic API, Copilot and Cursor (individual). Copilot exposes only the 5m write price. Context window inside Copilot is unverified (a 540K session was measured). Tokenizer of 4.7+ models produces ~30% more tokens than Opus 4.6/4.5 for the same text (F11).

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5
models.note: Cache read cut from 0.20 to 0.10 on 2026-10-07. Available on Copilot Pro.

models.label: Claude Haiku 5.5
models.note: Threshold counts all input tokens including cache reads and writes; each request priced on its own.

models.label: Claude Fable 5.1
models.note: Read is 0.025x input. Not on Copilot Pro.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.8 (legacy)
models.note: Eligible for the experimental 1h TTL in VS Code Copilot (off by default).

models.label: Claude Opus 4.5 (legacy)
models.note: Older tokenizer: same text is ~30% fewer tokens than on Opus 4.7+.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.note: Writes are 1.25x input for the default 30-minute minimum lifetime (12h option at 2.5x, Responses API only, not used by Copilot per its price table). Promotional price at least through 2026-11-21. Context window not verified, so null.

models.label: GPT-6.1 Sol
models.note: Read is 0.05x. Prompts over 272K have higher rates (Copilot cache write 5.00); the full long-context row was not verified, so long_context is null. Output rate taken from the OpenAI API price list.

models.label: GPT-6 Astra
models.note: OpenAI API list price verified; the Copilot row for this model was not checked.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Luna
models.note: Long-context threshold in Copilot is 200K, not 272K.

models.label: GPT-5.3-Codex
models.note: Pre-5.6 model: no cache-write surcharge, a miss costs plain input. Deprecated on the OpenAI API. TTL in Copilot depends on retention requested (VS Code: 24h; CLI: unverified).

profiles.label: Claude Code on a Claude subscription (within plan usage)
profiles.credits_rule: No per-token charge inside the plan; tokens draw down the 5-hour session and weekly limits. Episode simplification: work fits inside the 5-hour limit. Over the limit, usage credits are billed and the main conversation drops to the 5m TTL (exact usage-credit rate not verified).
profiles.note: 60 applies to the main conversation only. Subagents, workflows/ultracode agents, teammates, forks and compaction get 5 unless subagentPromptCacheTtl is "1h". Open regression #103673: interactive CLI writing 5m since about 2026-10-14, so check ephemeral_1h_input_tokens or set promptCacheTtl "1h".

profiles.label: Claude Code with API key, default 5-minute TTL
profiles.credits_rule: USD = sum over categories of tokens/1e6 x Anthropic list rate. Warm turn: prefix x cache_read + new tokens x cache_write_5m + output. Turn after a gap > 5 min: whole context x cache_write_5m + output.
profiles.note: Default for API key, Bedrock, Google Cloud and Foundry. US-only inference adds 1.1x to every category (F12).

profiles.label: Claude Code with API key, 1-hour TTL
profiles.credits_rule: Same as API 5m but writes at cache_write_1h (2x input). A gap > 60 min re-writes the whole context at the 1h price. Set promptCacheTtl and subagentPromptCacheTtl to "1h", or ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1 (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M=1 overrides all).
profiles.note: Anthropic: worth it once ~1 turn in 20 follows a 5-60 min pause; with no pauses the 5m default is 15-19% cheaper. Choose at conversation start (switching mid-conversation costs one full re-write).

profiles.label: Cursor (individual Premium/Super/Ultra) with Claude or GPT
profiles.credits_rule: Paid from prepaid credit at API list price from the first request; no included Claude usage on The X Subscription. Cache write billed at Anthropic's 5m price. Gap > 5 min = full re-seed at cache write price.
profiles.note: TTL comes from staff forum posts, not docs. openai 30 is for GPT-5.6 (staff, July 2026); unknown since OpenAI's 12h option of 2026-10-20. Older OpenAI models "24 hours" per staff, an OpenAI ceiling. Not offered in Cursor: GPT-6 / 6.1 / Astra, Opus 4.5. GPT-5.6 Luna long context starts at 272K (Copilot 200K). OpenAI's proposed shutoff of GPT in Cursor: 2026-11-12. Regional/US-only endpoints +10%. Requires Premium ($30) or higher.

profiles.label: Cursor Teams/Enterprise with Claude or GPT
profiles.credits_rule: API list price plus a flat 0.25 USD per million tokens on input, output and cached tokens (cache reads and writes), including BYOK. Haiku 5.5 and GPT-5.6 Luna exempt (exclusion list re-checked 2026-11-01).
profiles.note: Opus 5.5 effective: read 0.45, write 5.25, input 4.25, output 20.25. Surcharge is flat, not a percentage, so markup_pct is null.

profiles.label: GitHub Copilot (AI credits) with Claude
profiles.credits_rule: credits = sum over categories (input, cached input, cache write, output) of tokens/1e6 x model rate / 0.01. Rates equal vendor list price. Included monthly allowance: Pro 1,500, Pro+ 7,000, Max 20,000, Business 1,900/user pooled, Enterprise 3,900/user pooled; no carry-over; overage at the same rate. Only one cache-write price is published (Anthropic 5m tier).
profiles.note: 5 min is from VS Code source and Copilot CLI logs, not stated by GitHub (GitHub's tutorial wrongly says 1h). VS Code has an experimental extendedTtl (off by default) that does not cover Claude 5.x. Opus models only on Pro+ and Max. Whether a 1h write would be billed at 2x is unverified.

profiles.label: GitHub Copilot (AI credits) with GPT-5.6 or later
profiles.credits_rule: Same credit formula as copilot-claude. GPT-5.6+ bill a cache write at 1.25x input (30m tier); reads 0.1x (0.05x on GPT-6.1 Sol/Terra). Pre-5.6 models (GPT-5.3-Codex, GPT-5.4 nano) have no cache-write charge. Long-context tiers above 272K (200K for GPT-5.6 Luna).
profiles.note: 30 is a minimum lifetime refreshed on each read (OpenAI docs), matched by Copilot CLI logs (1800 s) and measurements; GitHub does not state it. For GPT-5.3-Codex VS Code requests 24h retention; CLI behaviour unverified.
